sources.label: Morphe patches for Pdb (pdb.app): premium unlock, ad removal, PairIP bypass and
sources.author: Madusha
patch_list: Disable AppsFlyer
Neutralizes AppsFlyer attribution/telemetry: the SDK is never initialized or started, and the JS bridge reports success as usual.
Disable CleverTap
Stops CleverTap session/activity tracking and push-click attribution. Push notifications themselves keep working.
Disable Firebase Performance + installer check
Makes Firebase Performance's connection wrapper a pass-through (no perf telemetry) and reports installs as Play-installed regardless of the actual installer.
Disable security checks
Stops MyDialog from exiting itself on root/debug/emulator/adb detection and on Play Integrity failure. Signature verification is reported clean so patched builds pass.
Disable SSL pinning

Removes certificate pinning at both layers (OkHttp pin comparison and the platform network-security-config pin-set) and trusts user-installed CAs, so HTTPS traffic can be inspected with a MITM proxy. Normal TLS validation stays intact.
Disable trackers
Disables Google Analytics measurement and Facebook SDK auto-init, and turns off Firebase Analytics/AdID data collection via their official opt-out flags.
Fix SIM identifier access

Replaces the IMSI lookup with the public getSimOperator() call so the pre-login flow passes on Android 11+ where re-signed builds lost carrier privileges ('App Error: NO IMSI'). Falls back to Dialog's 41305 on SIM-less devices.
Inspect HTTPS traffic (adb reverse proxy)
Routes RN network traffic through 127.0.0.1:8080 on the device (adb reverse tunnel to mitmproxy). Off by default; needs the tunnel and a trusted CA.
Kill residual beacon traffic

Silences the Facebook SDK's remaining phone-home: app-event uploads (/activities, /app) and the SDK config fetch (mobile_sdk_gk). The SDK class init stays alive (required by RN); only transmission dies.
Remove AI assistant FAB (+ footer patch id)
Removes the server-driven AI overlay FAB from every screen and surfaces the Morphe patch version on the side-menu footer ("ID ⚡<version>" next to the device id).
Spoof stock signing cert hash

Makes NativeUtils.setAppToken() return the stock app's certificate hash instead of the patched build's, so the server-side device/app integrity verdict ('App Error: NO IMSI') is not tripped by the re-signed APK.
Unlock hidden feature flags
Flips the server-sent feature flags showO2A/showO2AShop/showO2ABuy/showUber/showDeleteAccount to true in every API response before the JS sees it, revealing app screens the server hides.
